gap: Sourdough apparel is almost all slogans ('In My Sourdough Era', 'Wake and Bake', 'Sourdough Mama', 'Feed It. Use It. Chill It. Repeat.') or a cartoon (a frog with a starter jar); the only watercolor found was a baking-pattern wrap mug. None found shows a painted sourdough still life (a floured, scored boule with its ear, a jar of risen starter with its rubber band, open-crumb slices, wheat and a striped linen towel) on a shirt, and no 'Sourdough Season' title turned up. Our angle: a cozy watercolor bake-day scene in the shop's 'X Season' format, for light shirts and mugs.
trend: Sourdough gift guides dated 2026 (Country Roads Sourdough, About Darwin September 2026, That Sourdough Gal) and Food Network's gifts-for-the-baker guide are live; Target and Walmart both carry sourdough sweatshirts, so the niche is mainstream. Printful's 2026 Etsy guide says shoppers keep turning to Etsy for creative hobbies, and its winter guide puts sweatshirts and hoodies at the top of winter sellers, selling through December gifting into January. Etsy's 2025 holiday edit (the newest found) favors personal, tradition-honoring gifts. No search-volume numbers were available, so demand is judged from these pages, not counted.
